version: LOCK 26 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - learning: the Names of Allah
builds_on: LOCK 1 places, LOCK 2 Idris (after meeting him), LOCK 8 private record pattern. Placeholders: {n}, {m}.

names.idris: Idris traces the letters with his finger. “As-Salam. Every peace you have ever felt came from Him. That is why we say salam to each other.”

names.where: Painted on the lintel over Salma's oven.
names.idris: Idris smiles at the bread queue. “Ar-Razzaq. Salma bakes, but the bread is His gift. When you feed people, you only pass it on.”

names.where: Cut into the beam of the market scales.
names.idris: Idris taps the beam. “Al-Hasib. Old Musa weighs the grain. Allah weighs everything else - even what nobody saw.”
